cards.name: Farad, the Ohmechanic Capacitor

effects.printed_clause: 2 monsters including a Thunder monster; ATK becomes 0 with no Current Counters; threshold effects.
effects.lua_implementation: Link procedure requires exactly two with at least one Thunder; a single-range final ATK effect and threshold conditions implement the static framework.

official_references.matched_structure: Link material subgroup check and continuous single-range effect structure.

effects.printed_clause: 1+: During the Main Phase, target and banish 1 opponent card; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition effect at 1+ counters targets an opponent on-field removable card and banishes it, with key id.

official_references.matched_structure: Targeted on-field removal operation and HOPT trigger/activation structure.

effects.printed_clause: 2+: During the Main Phase, target an "Ohmen" in your GY or banishment and add it; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition at 2+ targets a face-up removed or GY Ohmen, applies Necrovalley filtering to GY, and returns it with key id+100.

official_references.matched_structure: Targeting a banished/GY card and returning it to a destination.

effects.printed_clause: 3+: Quick Effect, remove all Current Counters from this card and co-linked Link Monsters; banish up to 3 cards in opponent GY; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: The mutual-linked group is the co-linked Link Monster group; the cost removes every Current Counter from it and this card, then the standard non-target removal operation selects one to three opponent GY cards.

official_references.matched_structure: Mutual-linked group acquisition used for the distributed counter cost.
